comment: Role of this tool relative to others:
- Indentation & line length for code (py/ts/js/css): ALREADY enforced
by ruff-format, prettier, eslint. We disable them here to avoid
redundant / conflicting opinions (e.g. indentation inside Python
docstrings legitimately varies for markdown rendering).
- This tool focuses on file-level invariants that code formatters do
NOT cover: line endings (LF), final newline, trailing whitespace,
and charset (UTF-8). These are the things that break diffs and CI
